Structs§

ElfCache
Main-owned parsed modules keyed by verified file versions and mapping identities. The cache bounds source-file bytes to 128 MiB and parsed entries to 64; it also retains at most 64 rejected versions without their file bytes. Unwinder-held Arcs may outlive cache eviction.
ElfSymbols
Parsed ELF data from verified bytes acquired by the helper. The DWARF context uses owned, bounded section bytes and never opens supplementary or split debug files.
